name: sigma-cross-org-port
description: Copy a Sigma workbook from one Sigma org into another when both orgs already read the same warehouse tables. Reference-remapping over a spec copied verbatim; audit-first, verify-hard-after. Not a BI-tool converter and not a data migration.

plugins.name: sigma-cross-org-port
plugins.description: Sigma org A → Sigma org B workbook copy over the REST API: remap org-scoped refs (connections, image uploads), fix the GET→POST asymmetries, create on the contents endpoints, verify structure + compilation + render.
